balance-of-payments-accounts.alt: Two panels for the invented country Arland, in billions of arls. Current account: exports of goods and services plus 400, imports minus 520, net income from abroad plus 30, net transfers minus 10, for a current account balance of minus 100, a deficit. Capital and financial account: foreigners buy Arland assets plus 250, Arlanders buy foreign assets minus 150, for a balance of plus 100, a surplus. The two balances sum to zero.
